verdict.rationale: Reflect ships a public REST API with OAuth 2, so this axis applies. However, its API docs explicitly document no versioning or deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI package's info version "0.1.0" is only a spec label, not a versioned-API scheme with deprecation commitments. Absence of an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
